51579240.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to CM5 sensor chip immobilized human B3GAT3 assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.SPR Analysis: The binding affinity of the compounds to B3GAT3 was determined using a Biacore T200 with a CM5 sensor chip (Cytiva, USA). Briefly, 80 μg/mL B3GAT3 (in phosphate-buffered saline (PBS), pH 7.5; DetaBio, China) was immobilized onto the sensor chip previously activated with 1 min pulse of 10 mM sodium acetate (pH 4.5; Sigma, USA). The first flow cell was used as a reference surface to control nonspecific binding. Both flow cells were injected with the analyte (in PBS-P, 5% DMSO (Topscience, China), pH 7.5) at a flow rate of 30 μL/min at 25 °C in increasing concentrations. The data were analyzed by global fitting of the equilibrium binding responses from various concentrations of analytes using a 1:1 Langmuir binding model.
